Description (SPA): Identificador sintetico de candidatura, construido en la limpieza a partir de election_id, las columnas de alcance de la carrera judicial y NO_CANDIDATO.
Description (ENG): Synthetic candidate identifier, built during cleaning from election_id, the race's scope columns, and NO_CANDIDATO.
Values / Domain: Text key such as MIN_2025|CAND34 or TCCA_2025|1|2|CAND05.
Notes: Not the raw source key: NO_CANDIDATO alone (e.g. CAND01) is reused across every judicial district sharing a race's file, so it cannot identify a candidate on its own.

Description (SPA): Concurso judicial al que pertenece la candidatura.
Description (ENG): Judicial race to which the candidacy belongs.
Values / Domain: MIN_2025, TDJ_2025, TEPJF_SS_2025, TEPJF_SR_2025, TCCA_2025, JD_2025.

Description (SPA): Circuito judicial federal de la carrera, cuando la eleccion esta organizada por circuito.
Description (ENG): Federal judicial circuit for the race, when the election is organized by circuit.
Notes: Populated for TCCA and JD only; part of the candidato_id scope for those two races.

Description (SPA): Distrito judicial electoral de la carrera, cuando la eleccion esta organizada por distrito.
Description (ENG): Judicial electoral district for the race, when the election is organized by district.
Notes: Populated for TCCA and JD only; part of the candidato_id scope for those two races.

Description (SPA): Circunscripcion electoral (1-5) de la carrera, cuando la eleccion esta organizada por region.
Description (ENG): Electoral circunscription (1-5) for the race, when the election is organized by region.
Notes: Populated for TEPJF_SR only; part of the candidato_id scope for that race. Reuses the same 1-5 numbering as dim_geography.circunscripcion (diputados RP circunscripciones).

Description (SPA): Entidad federativa registrada para la candidatura en el catalogo fuente.
Description (ENG): State registered for the candidacy in the source catalog.
Values / Domain: 1-32, or 0 for the three national-at-large races.
Notes: Informational only for TCCA/JD -- NOT part of the candidato_id scope, because a judicial district's registered entidad here can differ from the entidad of casillas that actually vote in it (districts can straddle a state line).

Description (SPA): Numero de candidato tal como aparece en el catalogo fuente, unico solo dentro del alcance de la carrera.
Description (ENG): Candidate number as it appears in the source catalog, unique only within the race's own scope.
Notes: Not globally unique; use candidato_id for joins.

Description (SPA): Etiqueta de columna del acta (CAND01, CAND02, ...) que identifica a la candidatura dentro de su alcance.
Description (ENG): Ballot-column label (CAND01, CAND02, ...) identifying the candidacy within its scope.
Values / Domain: CAND01 through CAND84, depending on the race.
Notes: Matches a wide-format column name in the source votes CSV before melting; reused across every judicial district for TCCA/JD.

Description (SPA): Nombre de la candidata o candidato, Apellido Paterno Apellido Materno Nombre.
Notes: As published by INE; not re-cased or re-ordered.

Description (SPA): Genero de la candidatura segun el catalogo fuente.
Description (ENG): Candidate gender per the source catalog.
Notes: Source values kept as published (M = mujer, H = hombre).

Description (SPA): Materia o especialidad de la candidatura (por ejemplo Civil, Penal, Laboral, Mixto).
Description (ENG): Subject-matter specialty of the candidacy (e.g. Civil, Penal, Laboral, Mixto).
Notes: Only present for TCCA and JD candidacies; NULL for the other four races.

Description (SPA): Poder(es) de la Union que postulo a la candidatura.
Description (ENG): Branch(es) of government that nominated the candidacy.
Values / Domain: PE, PJ, PL, EF, or a hyphenated combination such as PE-PL-PJ.
Notes: PE=Ejecutivo, PJ=Judicial, PL=Legislativo, EF=Comite de Evaluacion; a candidacy can be jointly postulated by more than one.

Description (SPA): Indica si la candidatura fue cancelada por incompatibilidad o renuncia.
Description (ENG): Indicates whether the candidacy was cancelled for incompatibility or withdrawal.
Notes: A cancelled candidacy can still appear in the votes file if ballots had already been printed.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
Notes: Warehouse-only field; not present in clean parquet inputs.
